name: Wood Rot
body:
School transmutation [wood]; Level druid 4

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S

Range touch

Effect one non-magical wooden object (or the volume of the object within 3 ft. of the touched point) or one plant creature

Duration instantaneous

Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

Wood: Spells with this descriptor include those that directly create, utilize, or manipulate plant or wood in some manner or conjure creatures with the plant subtype or composed of wood. Such spells are considered to belong to the Wood element (for geomancers) and the Wood elemental school (for wood elementalists).

You touch the wooden object and it begins to degrade with a terrible wood rot. The subject wooden object or part of a larger wooden object is destroyed and crumbles into wood dust.

This can be used to sunder a wooden or wooden-hafted weapon as a melee touch attack. This still provokes an attack of opportunity if you do not possess the requisite feats. If the object is a shield or other protection too large to be fully targeted, the wielder instead takes a – 1d6 penalty to their AC (to a maximum of the AC provided by the object).

If used on a plant creature, the melee touch deals 3d6 damage + 1 per caster level (maximum +15).
